RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, December 10, 2010/Agrahayana 19, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Agriculture;  Chemicals  and  Fertilizers;  Communications and
Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution;
Earth Sciences; Human Resource Development; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Science and Technology; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
139
Railway projects running behind
schedule in U.P.
*441. SHRI MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of railway projects which
are running behind schedule in Uttar
Pradesh under North Eastern Railway;
(b) the reasons for the same;
(c) the extent of cost and time overruns
as a result thereof;
(d) the responsibility fixed in the matter;
and
(e) the steps taken to avoid such a
situation in future?
Public investment in agriculture sector
*442. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: W ill the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether  it  is  a  fact  that  public
investment in agriculture has declined during
the last five years;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether Government has taken any
serious step to overcome the present crisis
in agriculture?
Suicide by farmers in Orissa
*443. SHRI RAMA CHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a poor farmer
of Dubakona village in Dashrathpur block
of Jajpur district, Orissa has committed
suicide for not being able to pay the loan
which he had taken for cultivation;
(b) if so, how many farmers in Orissa
have committed suicide till now and the
amount of compensation paid to the
bereaved  families  by  Government;
and

140
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) the preventive steps taken by
Government to check such unfortunate
incidents in future?
Bungling in railway procurement
†*444. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has been
informed by a railway officer of the
bungling of ` 10 thousand crores by
mechanical department every year in
railway procurement;
(b) if  so,  the  steps  taken  by
Government so far to ascertain the truth
thereof;
(c) the names of the officials bribed by
an American company to get the contract
of Brake Block in the year 2008 and the
action taken against them so far; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Payment to victims of train accident
†*445. SHRI    SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to refer to the
answer to Unstarred Question 574 given in
the Rajya Sabha on 12 November, 2010
and state:
(a) the total number of victims who have
been made ex-gratia  payment and the
number of those who are deprived of such
payment so far;
(b) the reasons for not making ex-gratia
payment to rest of the affected people and
by when this ex-gratia payment would be
made to them;
(c) the funds sanctioned in the years
2009-10 and 2010-11 for each additional
security gadget/system being installed for
checking accidents and the amount spent
till September, 2010; and
(d) the zones where security gadgets/
systems have been installed/are being
installed?
Prediction of cloud burst
*446. SHRIMA TI    VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of EARTH
SCIENCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether  Indian  Meteorological
Department (IMD) has been failing
in prediction of cloud bursts in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) the details of funds allocated and
spent on tracking the variability of weather
forecast systems in the country during
the last three years and the current year,
year-wise;
(d) whether the scientists are also sent
abroad to study weather forecast system
of the country;
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
amount spent by Government in this regard
during the aforesaid period; and
(f) the benefits accrued as a result
thereof?

141
Authorisation to export iron ore
*447. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of STEEL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
any request from Metal Scrap Trading
Corporation Ltd. (MSTC) seeking
authorization to export iron ore on the
pattern of export being done by Minerals
and Metals Trading Corporation (MMTC);
and
(b) if so, the details of the request
received from MSTC and the action taken
or proposed to be taken thereon?
Seats     for     weaker     and     socially
disadvantaged background children
under RTE Act
*448. SHRIMATI KANIMOZHI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether according to section 12 of
the Right to Education Act, all private
unaided schools must allocate 25 per cent
of the seats in Class I (or lowest grade) for
children from economically weaker and
socially disadvantaged backgrounds;
(b) whether Government has decided
upon the definition of economically weaker
and socially disadvantaged backgrounds;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether Government has
recommended a formula for implementation
of section 12 of the Act and if so, the details
thereof?
Food security crisis
†*449. SHRI PRABHA T JHA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
food security crisis is looming over the
country as a result of acquisition of
cultivable land;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the measures taken by Government
to deal with the food security crisis keeping
in view the global foodgrain crisis witnessed
in the year 2008;
(d) whether Government thinks that
increase in the average income as a result of
industrialisation would enable people to
procure foodgrains from market; and
(e) if so, the source from where
Government would make agricultural land
available for securing availability of
additional foodgrains?
Vacant faculty posts in
PSSCIVE
*450. SHRI SHADI LAL BATRA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has set up
Pandit Sunderlal Sharma Central Institute
of V ocational Education (PSSCIVE) under
NCERT as an apex body for growth and
development of vocational education in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government is aware of a
large number of vacant faculty and
administrative positions in PSSCIVE;
(d) if so, the details of vacant posts
during each of the last five years, till date,
faculty-wise;
(e) the reasons for such vacancies for
past several years; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

142
(f) the action taken by Government to
fill these faculty positions so as to develop
the vocational education programme in the
country?
Private investment in agriculture
sector
*451. SHRIMATI   GUNDU
SUDHARANI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) to what extent Government has
succeeded in bringing in more private
investment in agriculture sector;
(b) the details of private sector and
public investment in agriculture sector
during the last five years, year-wise and
State-wise; and
(c) to what extent schemes like
Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana, National
Food Security Mission, Development and
Strengthening of Infrastructure Facilities for
Production and Distribution of Quality
Seeds, etc., help in attracting private
investment in agriculture sector?
Development of khadi and village
industries
*452. SHRI NARESH GUJRAL: Will
the Minister of MICRO, SMALL AND
MEDIUM ENTERPRISES be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of people employed in
the khadi and village industries, till
December, 2009;
(b) the total turnover and the profit of
these industries in the last three years; and
(c) the total amount spent on
development of such industries by the
Central Government during the last three
years?
Porters in Railways
*453. SHRI R.C. SINGH: Will the
Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that thousands of
licensed porters are presently working in
Railways;
(b) if so, the details thereof, zone-wise;
(c) whether it is also a fact that porters
are not covered under the Rashtriya
Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY);
(d) if so, the reasons therefor;
(e) whether Government will bring them
under RSBY in view of demands from
licensed porters; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
Utilization certificates of grants-in-
aid
*454. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) names of institutions which have
not submitted utilization certificates for
over three years as on 1 December, 2010 in
respect of grants-in-aid given to them with
the outstanding amount date from which
amount was outstanding and the reasons
given for non-submission of utilization
certificate in each case;

143
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) maximum time allowed to grantee
institutions for submission of utilization
certificates, before treating the grant having
been misappropriated and initiation of
action for its recovery;
(c) whether involvement of
departmental officials in non-submission
of utilization certificates for over three
years has been investigated;
(d) if so, findings thereof; and
(e) if not, reasons therefor?
Telephone Exchange in Kali Bari,
New Delhi
*455. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether MTNL has recently
commissioned a Telephone Exchange in Kali
Bari area of New Delhi;
(b) if so, the details of the area covered
by this Exchange;
(c) whether all broadband connections
coming under the jurisdiction of this new
Exchange are functioning properly; and
(d) if not, the status of complaints
registered by the broadband users for its
non-functioning and by when the proper
functioning from this Exchange will begin?
BSNL Telephone Exchange Building
*456. SHRI P AUL MANOJ
PANDIAN: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
construct BSNL Telephone Exchange
Building at Cheranmahadevi and Pathamadai
panchayat towns of Tirunelveli district of
Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether BSNL Telephone Exchange
Buildings have been constructed in
Tirunelveli district of Tamil Nadu?
Recruitment of Postal Assistants
†*457. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the eligibility criteria prescribed for
recruitment of Postal Assistants (Dak
Sahayak) in pay scale of Rs. 5200-20200
with grade pay of Rs. 2400/- in Postal
Department;
(b) whether the recruitment process for
this post has recently been completed in
Chhindwara division and applications of
all such applicants who have no diploma in
computer education have been rejected;
(c) whether recruitment process of
Postal Assistants in Chhindwara division
was accomplished as per rules and only
eligible persons have been appointed for
the posts; and
(d) the reasons for cancellation of
applications on this basis if diploma in
computer education was not essential?

144
Smuggling of PDS foodgrains
*458. SHRI MANGALA KISAN: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Public Distribution System
(PDS) foodgrains from godowns of FCI
are being smuggled/diverted to Bangladesh
via Nepal;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of foodgrains recovered
from smugglers during last three years,
alongwith the smugglers arrested, State-
wise; and
(d) the details of cases lodged against
smugglers and other action taken against
them to prevent illegal smuggling and
diversion of foodgrains?
Fake institute being run as a deemed
university
*459. SHRI A.A. JINNAH: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that a
fake institute being run by a Professor of
IIT, Kharagpur has claimed to be a deemed
university; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the action
Government proposes to take against those
who are responsible to issue authorisation
for the deemed university?
Superfast train between New Delhi
and Guwahati
*460. SHRI KUMAR DEEPAK DAS:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has any
proposal for introduction of a superfast
train between New Delhi and Guwahati;
(b) whether Government will introduce
such superfast express train as additional
Rajdhani Express, making it to stop only at
four or five stations namely Guwahati, New
Jalpaiguri, Mugalsarai and New Delhi, etc.;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 4th December, 2010 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 13, 1932 (Saka)
